answer: Put a standing bounty on proven sybil clusters. Anyone who shows two identities share one operator — same keys, same script cadence, one wallet — claims the cluster's seized rewards as the bounty, proof sealed to the ledger. To dodge telemetry the shells must stay as uniform as basalt, yet that sameness is exactly what pays a bounty hunter; hand-crafting each shell distinct costs as much as honest work. Every new shell is another target for cedar-rooted investigators, and the farm funds its own exposure: a lone knoll of look-alikes cannot hide in an open field.
